items.exampleEn: The shop answers every complaint quickly.
items.exampleZh: 這家店對每一件投訴都很快回應。

items.exampleEn: Everyone listened quietly to the speaker.
items.exampleZh: 大家都安靜地聽演講者說話。

items.exampleEn: We advise visitors to arrive early.

items.exampleZh: 這台電腦太慢，跑不動新遊戲。

items.exampleEn: The actor forgot a line in the script.
items.exampleZh: 那位演員忘了劇本裡的一句台詞。

items.exampleEn: The web has lots of free English lessons.
items.exampleZh: 網路上有很多免費的英文課程。

items.sentenceEn: I do my homework on my PC.

items.audioEn: The speaker will start at ten, so please sit down.
items.audioZh: 演講者十點開始，請大家坐好。

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother learned to use the web last year.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶去年學會了上網。

items.sentenceEn: It is hard to communicate in a foreign language.

items.stemEn: My teacher ____ me to read more English books.
items.stemZh: 老師建議我多讀英文書。

items.stemEn: The hotel got a ____ about the noise from room 305.
items.stemZh: 飯店接到一件有關 305 號房噪音的投訴。

items.passageEn: This semester, our class is making a short movie. Nina wrote the script, and I am one of the actors. We find ideas on the web and work on the movie on my PC. On some days, we don't communicate well, and people criticize each other's ideas. Our headteacher advised us, "Listen first, then talk." Last week, a famous director came to our school as a speaker and talked about making movies.
items.passageZh: 這學期，我們班在拍一部短片。Nina 寫了劇本，我是演員之一。我們在網路上找點子，用我的電腦做影片。有些日子大家溝通得不好，會互相批評彼此的想法。校長給我們的建議是：「先聽，再說。」上週，一位有名的導演來我們學校演講，談怎麼拍電影。

items.promptZh: 我們每天用電子郵件溝通。
referenceEn: We communicate by email every day.
Every day, we communicate by email.
rubricZh: 「用電子郵件」可寫例如 by email

items.promptZh: 那部新電影被很多人批評。
referenceEn: The new movie was criticized by many people.
Many people criticized the new movie.
rubricZh: 用 criticize 表示「批評」，主動或被動寫法都可以
時態可用過去式、現在完成式或現在式（例如 was criticized、has been criticized、is criticized 等）
